actions: Reimplemented the published Gaussian SNML predictor independently and checked the r68/r72 exact identity to machine precision for burn-ins 2, 4 and 16.
Independently verified location/scale invariance, start-weight threshold arithmetic, state counts and pair-failure inequality.
Reverse-checked the three worker-reported simultaneous CP upper bounds and recovered exact implied worst marginal failure counts 100, 214 and 125 out of 4000.
Independently reimplemented the complete certified 15 variance-ratio x 17 integer-offset x 3-scale subgroup sufficient-statistic simulation and reran it under three fresh seeds.

Identified an exact-replay ambiguity in the non-certifying 21x33 dense scan for g=16 because 33 evenly spaced offsets imply half-observation positions unless a rounding/interpolation rule is specified.

result.summary: The 10-state cross-field conditional-SNML bank is independently reproduced at the finite-grid conclusion level. Across three fresh independent seeds, worst simultaneous CP pair-failure upper bounds remained below 0.10 on all three scales and close to worker-reported values. Exact worker-run replay remains unavailable without seed/code/raw matrix; continuum coverage is still unproved.

termination_cause: Physical invocation checkpoint after one complete source-qualified audit; recurring frontier remains nonempty and no global completion is claimed.
exact_next_action: Next bootstrap-valid invocation: avoid unchanged r72 unless a reopen condition appears; audit a different exact sealed-wave non-evaluation candidate, preferring open_source or another under-audited namespace with executable official material.
